item.title: Trump Encourages Sen. John Fetterman to Switch Parties
item.description: President Donald Trump publicly urged Democratic Sen. John Fetterman of Pennsylvania to become a Republican, weeks before the election.

item.title: Actor Assaulted and Robbed in West Hollywood, Seeks Response from Newsom and Bass
California Faces Unlikely Tax Revolt Over Immigrant Healthcare Costs
item.description: California Medicaid costs prompt Gavin Newsom's new health insurance tax, but doctors and insurers sue, claiming it violates Proposition 35.

item.title: Lobsterman's Privacy Fight Reaches Supreme Court, Could Have Broad Impact
item.description: Frank Thompson calls GPS tracking on his lobster boat a 24/7 "ankle bracelet" after the Supreme Court declined to hear his Fourth Amendment case.
